why: No major reviewer or authority tests 65W chargers with interchangeable plugs. WIRED and Android Central review travel adapters and mention one such charger each in passing. The rest are brand product pages, affiliate roundups (CNA, thai-aec, distinctivetravels) and a single-product niche review. A focused comparison with current prices and a clear pick would stand out.
